title: The North River Steam Boat advertisement in the American Citizen
version: New York State Library BOX 409, 2 September 1807 issue
lineage: Cropped facsimile of the American Citizen original and a separate transcription on the state library’s site.

passages.locator: 2 September 1807, The North River Steam Boat advertisement, New York State Library BOX 409
passages.note: The printed advertisement offers an Albany passage from Paulas Hook ferry on Friday, 4 September, and lists a fare of seven dollars for Albany.
